local chosen = "Animation1"

function play_anim(model)
	local controller = nil 
	if model:FindFirstChild("AnimationController") then
		controller = model:WaitForChild("AnimationController")
	else
		controller = Instance.new("AnimationController")
		controller.Parent = model
	end
	local animation = script:WaitForChild(chosen)
	
	local animtrack = controller:LoadAnimation(animation)
	--print("fak")
	animtrack:Play()
end

while true do

	play_anim(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Super"))

	wait(4)
end
